title: A renewed picture connects different states

captions.energy: Ending an explanation without remaining grounds

meaning: Your shared view can connect earlier and present experience when an ended explanation no longer replaces changed conditions.
text: Harmony can appear after recognising that an earlier explanation has finished its work. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna suggests updating your view when conditions change. Death in energy supports wanting to end an account whose grounds have run out. Temperance in emotions feels different aspects fit together. You may enjoy earlier and present experience finding understandable places. Your view no longer requires one arrangement to explain every state, preserving connections between what stood out before and what has changed now.

Suppose you examine window photographs before and after clear glass was replaced with frosted glass. The earlier explanation of sharp reflections no longer fits. **An ended account can help connect different states of one experience.** You update the description and notice how soft light relates to the new surface. Both impressions keep their grounds. It feels pleasing that earlier sharp reflections and present diffusion concern different conditions. Your understanding can accommodate them together without assessing one state as the only correct or more authentic one.

The risk is smoothing over a significant difference because harmony feels pleasant and losing sight of what ended. The earlier account returns as though still applicable. Wanting to finish what is exhausted preserves accuracy: different states belong to one object’s history while each explanation remains distinct without replacing the other.
